mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_source_version WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND version_no=#{versionNo}

SELECT d.id,d.document_code documentCode,d.title,d.status,d.retry_count retryCount,s.id sourceId,s.name sourceName,s.storage_path storagePath,s.authority_score authorityScore,s.permission_tags permissionTags,s.source_type sourceType,sv.version_no sourceVersion,sv.id sourceVersionId,s.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(cu.revision) FROM t_content_unit cu WHERE cu.document_id=d.id),1) chunkRevision FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE d.id=#{id}

SELECT id,source_code sourceCode,knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId,name,source_type sourceType,source_uri sourceUri,authority_score authorityScore,owner_user_id ownerUserId,effective_at effectiveAt,expire_at expireAt,scope,status,permission_tags permissionTags,created_time createdTime FROM t_source WHERE knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) AND (permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(permission_tags)=0) ORDER BY created_time DESC

SELECT s.id sourceId,s.source_code sourceCode,s.name name,s.source_type sourceType,s.source_uri sourceUri, s.storage_path storagePath,s.authority_score authorityScore,s.status status,s.created_time createdTime, d.id documentId,d.document_code documentCode,d.title documentTitle,d.mime_type mimeType, d.parse_status parseStatus,d.chunk_count chunkCount,d.raw_text rawText FROM t_source s LEFT JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.source_id=s.id AND sv.version_no=1 LEFT JOIN t_document d ON d.source_version_id=sv.id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND s.id=#{sourceId} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0
OR (JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) ) LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id,d.document_code documentCode,d.title,d.mime_type mimeType,d.parse_status parseStatus,d.status,d.current_stage currentStage,d.error_message errorMessage,d.retry_count retryCount,d.chunk_count chunkCount,s.name sourceName,s.id sourceId,d.created_time createdTime FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE s.knowledge_base_id=#{kb} AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0 OR JSON_CONTAINS(s.permission_tags, JSON_QUOTE(#{tag}))) AND (s.permission_tags IS NULL OR JSON_LENGTH(s.permission_tags)=0) ORDER BY d.created_time DESC

SELECT cu.id unitId,cu.unit_code unitCode,cu.heading_path headingPath,cu.chunk_type chunkType,cu.page_no pageNo,cu.content content,e.evidence_code evidenceCode FROM t_content_unit cu LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.content_unit_id=cu.id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId} AND cu.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY cu.id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_content_unit SET status='SUPERSEDED' WHERE document_id=#{documentId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision),0)+1 FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id=#{documentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_content_unit SET parent_id = CASE unit_code WHEN #{row.unitCode} THEN #{row.parentId} END WHERE unit_code IN #{row.unitCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id,unit_code unitCode,chunk_type chunkType,heading_path headingPath,page_no pageNo,page_end pageEnd,char_start charStart,char_end charEnd,token_count tokenCount,status,source_version sourceVersion,revision,parent_id parentId,LEFT(content,200) excerpt,CHAR_LENGTH(content) contentLength,created_time createdTime FROM t_content_unit WHERE document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM t_content_unit WHERE unit_code=#{unitCode}
SELECT id,unit_code unitCode FROM t_content_unit WHERE unit_code IN #{code}

SELECT d.id documentId, d.title title, d.raw_text rawText, s.id sourceId, s.knowledge_base_id knowledgeBaseId, s.authority_score authorityScore, CAST(IFNULL(s.permission_tags,'') AS CHAR) permissionTags FROM t_document d JOIN t_source_version sv ON sv.id=d.source_version_id JOIN t_source s ON s.id=sv.source_id WHERE d.id=#{documentId}

SELECT cu.id content_unit_id, cu.heading_path heading_path, cu.content content, cu.page_no page_no, cu.page_end page_end, cu.char_start char_start, cu.char_end char_end, cu.chunk_type chunk_type, cu.token_count token_count, e.evidence_code evidence_code FROM t_content_unit cu LEFT JOIN t_evidence e ON e.content_unit_id=cu.id WHERE cu.document_id=#{documentId} ORDER BY cu.id
mapper.update: UPDATE t_document SET extraction_status=#{status}, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
UPDATE t_document SET index_status=#{status}, updated_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{id}
